Vermin · SM +1 Monstrous Scorpion (Large) [Monster Manual, page 287]

A cobalt-black scorpion as big as a pony, eight-legged, with bronze-edged pincers heavy enough to hold a struggling adult still and a red-brown sting arched over its back. It hears movement through the ground long before it sees anything, and it does not startle or retreat.

Poison: Toxic Attack 1d-1 (Cyclic, 1 hour, 4 cycles, Resistible, +40%; Follow-Up, Sting, +0%; Resistible, HT-3, -15%; Symptoms, 2/3 HP, -2 HT and -1 DX, +20%) Resolve as stated by the construction; the source gives no separate resolution text.13thrust 1d+2 impaling (KYOS: 2d+1 impaling) plus follow-up 1d-1 toxic (4 1-hour cycles, resisted by HT-3, -2 HT and -1 DX after loss of 2/3 HP)C-1
PincersPincers (13): thrust 1d+1 cutting (KYOS: 2d-1 cutting), Reach C-1. The monstrous scorpion can either nip and let go or hold on and grapple the victim in addition to injuring him. Either is an attack that takes full hit location penalties – not halved for grappling. Treat this attack as a bite for these purposes (see Teeth on page 115 of GURPS Martial Arts for details). The pincers give +2 with tasks that require a firm grip (including climbing).13thrust 1d+1 cutting (KYOS: 2d-1 cutting)C-1
